extracted.name: Rhubarb Cream Pie
extracted.description: This rhubarb cream pie recipe is easy to follow and makes a lovely deep-dish custard pie studded with lots and lots of fresh rhubarb with warm nutmeg.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
Mix together sugar, flour, and nutmeg in a large bowl. Stir in eggs. Add rhubarb; toss until thoroughly coated. Pour filling into pie shell.
Bake in the preheated oven for 50 to 60 minutes.
